cfg_implementation_boundary.semantic_predicate: PolicyScope && parser.ok && ir.ok && schema.ok && witness.ok && engine.ok && resources.ok

PARSER_CONSTRAINT.meaning: 输入必须可解析为单条查询语句，且不得包含 DML/DDL 或多语句副作用。
方言解析必须成功，并且解析出的方言在当前 PolicyScope 允许集合内。

SCHEMA.meaning: 原生 fixture 必须保留权威 schema 的表/列拼写；不能通过静默改名改变 SQL 名称解析。

ENGINE.meaning: MySQL 原生目标固定为 8.0.46 Linux 标识符模式；不匹配时只能报告 ENGINE_GAP，不能降级或归一化 SQL。

status_legend.TARGET: 产品希望支持，但当前代码尚未形成实现。
status_legend.IMPLEMENTED: 代码路径已存在，能够在受限输入下运行；尚未满足全局冻结证据要求。
status_legend.VERIFIED: 已经通过公开回归和冻结门禁，且没有未解释失败。
status_legend.OUT_OF_SCOPE: 当前产品契约明确不承诺。
status_legend.ENGINE_GAP: 契约允许，但所需原生执行器、驱动或连接不可用。
status_legend.INPUT_GAP: SQL/schema pair 无法在声明的 schema 或引擎标识符语义下 replay。
status_legend.UNDECIDED: 现有有限证据无法给出可靠确定结论。

verdict_mapping.student_wrong_rule: status == SUPPORTED && equivalence_conclusion == NOT_EQUIVALENT && judge_status == WRONG
verdict_mapping.fail_closed_rule: No other production status may produce a determinate student verdict.

PolicyScope.definition: 课程和 Phase 1 政策允许检查的 SQL pair、schema、dialect、版本和资源边界集合。

RunnableScope.definition: 输入已经通过 strict parser、IR/ASTDiff、schema qualification、witness planning、执行器可达性和资源门禁。
RunnableScope.machine_predicate: PolicyScope && parser.ok && ir.ok && schema.ok && witness.ok && engine.ok && resources.ok

FrozenPairScope.definition: 当前 freeze runner 实际生成并保存 mutation row 与 equivalence control 的 family 集合。
FrozenPairScope.known_limitation: 当前 runner 尚未把 parser、IR、schema、witness validator、engine 和资源状态全部作为同一门禁。

capabilities.name: 严格单条 DQL 解析
limits: 拒绝多语句、DML 和无法表示为 exp.Query 的输入
SQLGlot + 手写方言规则，不是独立 CFG 生成器
known_failures: 有限 CFG case 中存在 engine gap
全 SQL 语言覆盖未被证明

capabilities.name: 声明/检测方言解析
limits: regex 特征只能提供识别线索
识别成功不授予 IR、witness 或原生执行能力
known_failures: 声明方言与检测特征冲突时进入边界状态
方言版本兼容性仍需 runner 证据

capabilities.name: SQLStructureIR 与 ASTDiff
limits: scope metadata 有扫描节点、scope、edge、diff、binding 和路径深度上限
结构差异不是语义差异证明
known_failures: 有限 freeze 只验证声明 pair scope；v25 的 determinate label mismatch 为 0，但这不是全 SQL 语义完备性证明
结构可识别但执行器不可用时不能给语义 verdict

capabilities.name: SELECT、投影、谓词和 JOIN 结构
evidence: docs/34-Phase1-支持契约与验收术语.md#5-sql-结构范围
limits: NULL、重复行、空结果和相关作用域需要专门 witness
结果差异依赖 schema 和执行资源
known_failures: 无法满足 obligation 时保持 UNDECIDED
跨方言语义不能由 SQLite 代替

capabilities.name: 聚合、分组、排序和限制
limits: LIMIT/OFFSET 所需行数受 32 rows/table 上限约束
排序 tie、NULLS 和 vendor TOP/FETCH 需显式语义证据
known_failures: 大 LIMIT、复杂聚合或无法构造边界时为 UNDECIDED

capabilities.name: 集合运算、子查询和 CTE
evidence: docs/34-Phase1-支持契约与验收术语.md#5-sql-结构范围
limits: INTERSECT ALL/EXCEPT ALL、SEARCH/CYCLE 和复杂递归边界不完整
相关作用域和 NULL 语义可能缺少可满足 witness
known_failures: 复杂集合/递归输入可能为 ENGINE_GAP 或 UNDECIDED

capabilities.name: 窗口函数、分区、排序和 frame
limits: tie/frame/NULL 排序必须显式约束
SQLite 转译不能自动等同 vendor 窗口语义
known_failures: QUALIFY 及部分方言窗口结构不在完整执行范围

capabilities.name: compact schema 与 SchemaCatalog
limits: compact schema 的类型和约束只有显式声明时可靠
未知 nullability 按可空保守处理
known_failures: schema 不完整或无法 replay 时为 INPUT_GAP
其他 witness/engine 边界仍需跨层审计

capabilities.name: 作用域感知 schema qualification
limits: vendor 引擎最终名称解析仍可能不同
结构化 catalog 和 legacy schema 共存
known_failures: vendor 原生引擎的最终名称解析仍可能与静态 qualification 不同；标准 schema 无法 replay 时统一为 INPUT_GAP，学生侧缺失物理表仍按 WRONG 处理

capabilities.name: bounded witness planner 与 validator
limits: 8 worlds、8 attempts、32 rows/table
有限 witness 不能证明全局等价
known_failures: 约束冲突、world 上限或无法激活 obligation 时为 UNDECIDED

capabilities.name: mutation 与 equivalence control 生成
limits: freeze scope 当前只要求 mutation 和 equivalence control 生成
没有把 validator/engine/resource 全部纳入同一门禁
known_failures: freeze 只将 mutation/control pair generation 作为机械准入；复杂 SQL 仍可能在 Gold/production 层产生 ENGINE_GAP、INPUT_GAP 或 UNDECIDED

capabilities.name: SQLite bounded compatibility runner
evidence: docs/35-Phase1-真实代码能力盘点.md#7-执行器
limits: SQLite 兼容不等于 vendor 语义保真
转译成功不代表原生执行证明
known_failures: vendor-only syntax may be ENGINE_GAP or semantic boundary

capabilities.name: MySQL/PostgreSQL/T-SQL/Oracle 原生 runner
evidence: docs/34-Phase1-支持契约与验收术语.md#2-先区分两类数据库
limits: driver、URL、Docker engine 缺失即 ENGINE_GAP
MySQL 只接受 8.0.46 且要求 lower_case_table_names=0
MySQL fixture 表/列保留 source spelling；不改写提交 SQL
schema/query 的物理表或列名称解析失败属于 INPUT_GAP，不属于 ENGINE_GAP
版本兼容性依赖运行时配置
known_failures: 当前环境未证明所有 vendor runner 可达
不能静默用 SQLite 替代原生语义
其他 vendor 的完整名称解析 profile 仍需独立版本/配置证据

capabilities.name: 直接调用方言为 vendor 且未指定 backend
evidence: docs/35-Phase1-真实代码能力盘点.md#7-执行器
limits: 声明 vendor 方言时必须显式选择 auto/native 或明确 sqlite 兼容执行；未选择 backend 不进入 RunnableScope
known_failures: 缺少显式 backend 时返回 EXECUTION_BACKEND_REQUIRED/ENGINE_GAP；native runner 不可达时仍返回 ENGINE_GAP

capabilities.name: 查询级执行、结果和 witness 限制
evidence: docs/35-Phase1-真实代码能力盘点.md#8-资源限制
limits: SQLite 1,000,000 VM steps/0.5 秒
native 3 秒/10,000 rows/8 MiB
witness 8 worlds/8 attempts/32 rows per table
known_failures: 不同层限制尚未由同一机器可读 policy 生成

capabilities.name: 任务级硬超时、进程和内存隔离
evidence: docs/35-Phase1-真实代码能力盘点.md#8-资源限制
limits: 生产 real parser job 默认使用 spawn child、独立 process group、RLIMIT_AS/RLIMIT_CPU 和临时 pickle 结果交付；超时或清理时优先 SIGKILL 整个私有 process group；fork/forkserver 仅可显式配置；测试替身仍可走 thread seam
默认最多 2 个活动 child，额外最多 8 个请求占用 admission 名额；admission 等待和 work-slot 等待均为 5 秒，单次任务 wall-clock 上限为 45 秒
当前 worker 是按请求创建的 child；单次 child 崩溃后下一次请求会创建新 child，但尚未实现常驻 worker 池和跨实例队列
known_failures: 跨实例并发、真实多进程部署级故障恢复尚未完成；真实 OOM 演练尚未完成；CPU/内存/队列限制、硬超时、私有 process group descendant kill 和 child crash/recreate 已有公开回归

capabilities.name: 独立 Gold Oracle 五态结果
limits: bounded world 相同不能证明全局 EQUIVALENT
expected=EQUIVALENT 才能晋升有限等价结果
known_failures: 不可达 native engine 返回 ENGINE_GAP
没有反例且无可信等价标签返回 UNDECIDED

capabilities.name: 生产 SandboxRun rich status
evidence: docs/35-Phase1-真实代码能力盘点.md#9-verdict--结果状态
limits: 与 Gold/API 使用不同枚举
is_equivalent 兼容字段可能丢失边界原因
known_failures: unsupported feature 统一为 KNOWN_GAP；API 现在复用 phase1_verdict 的可教学 WRONG 门禁；Gold/production/API 尚未由同一生成器完整生成

capabilities.name: API 权威判定映射
evidence: docs/35-Phase1-真实代码能力盘点.md#9-verdict--结果状态
limits: API 的 CORRECT/WRONG/UNDECIDED 是对外简化层，不应覆盖内部 gap 原因
known_failures: 生产 rich verdict、Gold Oracle 和 API 尚未由同一生成器完整生成；失败状态映射已由 phase1_verdict.py 固化并有回归

capabilities.name: mutation/equivalence pair 冻结范围
limits: scope 主要表示 mutation/equivalence control 生成成功，不是完整 RunnableScope
known_failures: FrozenPairScope 不是完整 RunnableScope；复杂方言、不可达 native runner 和资源/验证边界仍按显式 gap 或 UNDECIDED 处理

freeze_baseline.feedback_policy: hidden outcomes are acceptance-only; no hidden SQL, labels, rows, or failure identities were read or used for optimization

resolved_public_witness_gaps.issue: COUNT(column) vs COUNT(*) was unreachable when a string WHERE literal matched no generated row
resolved_public_witness_gaps.resolution: final shared literal predicate path plus nullable COUNT measure

resolved_public_witness_gaps.issue: MIN/MAX witness was filtered out by an untyped string predicate
DISTINCT duplicate projection was unreachable after a string filter
resolved_public_witness_gaps.resolution: final shared literal predicate path and duplicate projected tuple

resolved_public_witness_gaps.issue: generic double-quoted schema column was executed as a string literal
IS NULL AND NOT IS NULL mutation was an unsatisfiable-to-unsatisfiable rewrite
resolved_public_witness_gaps.resolution: AST conjunction check rejects null predicate mutations inside a direct contradiction

resolved_public_witness_gaps.issue: UNION ALL to UNION in a strictly monotone bounded recursive sequence had no duplicate path
resolved_public_witness_gaps.resolution: Conservative recursive uniqueness proof leaves the mutation unavailable for this shape

resolved_public_witness_gaps.issue: Identical generated primary-key ranges hid the difference between IN and uncorrelated EXISTS
resolved_public_witness_gaps.resolution: Independent Gold Oracle plants a partial-key membership witness for simple subquery shapes

resolved_public_witness_gaps.issue: COUNT(*) to COUNT(id) was semantically equivalent when id was declared PRIMARY KEY
resolved_public_witness_gaps.resolution: Mutation context parses inline PRIMARY KEY/NOT NULL declarations and excludes guaranteed non-null columns

resolved_public_witness_gaps.issue: DISTINCT on a single-column PRIMARY KEY/UNIQUE projection cannot change multiplicity
resolved_public_witness_gaps.resolution: Mutation context parses single-column PRIMARY KEY/UNIQUE constraints and skips DISTINCT add/remove when the direct-table projection is proven unique; joins and composite keys remain fail-closed

resolved_public_witness_gaps.issue: Gold literal seeding did not reach Unicode or numeric-leading schema identifiers
resolved_public_witness_gaps.resolution: Independent Gold Oracle identifier lexer now accepts Unicode/numeric-leading names; generic/SQLite execution quotes numeric-leading schema headers, and stable evidence IDs canonicalize that representation-only quote so AST/obligation/mutation attribution remains bound

resolved_public_witness_gaps.issue: Schema-aware quoting repaired generic numeric-leading identifiers semantically but changed AST diff IDs
resolved_public_witness_gaps.resolution: Stable diff identity canonicalizes only numeric-leading double-quoted names present in the repaired diff representation; raw SQL semantics and vendor-dialect spelling remain unchanged

resolved_public_witness_gaps.issue: The 2026-08-25 public partition had no non-unique top-level DISTINCT source family, so the required distinct_removed mutation family was not emitted
resolved_public_witness_gaps.resolution: Added one explicitly marked public hand-authored non-unique projection fixture; the mutation, Gold obligation, validator, and production chain all pass without weakening the single-column uniqueness guard

latest_public_full_replay.resolution: The public partition now includes an explicit non-unique DISTINCT coverage fixture, restoring all 15 required mutation families while preserving the unique-projection fail-closed guard. The independent Gold Oracle now aligns simple conjunction boundaries and gives changed scalar aggregates a numeric separation witness, removing the four public NOT_EQUIVALENT-to-UNDECIDED cases; full public Gold is 2,102/2,102 classified with structure and atomic obligation coverage 1.0. The full production replay is 1,025 PASS / 26 EXCLUDED / 0 FAIL. MySQL source-spelled fixture names are preserved under lower_case_table_names=0; replayable MySQL mutations remain NOT_EQUIVALENT, while schema/query name mismatches remain INPUT_GAP. Generic numeric-leading identifiers are schema-quoted only for compatibility execution and retain the raw Gold diff identity through representation-only canonicalization. A mismatched MySQL version or identifier mode remains ENGINE_GAP.

latest_train_public_freeze_pair_regressi.resolution: Schema-aware numeric-leading identifier parsing now precedes the raw AST fallback, and freeze pairs use the mutation builder's canonical gold side. The public train/control replay has zero determinate label mismatches; production chain has zero failures.

public_freeze_pair_regression.resolution: The public snapshot and exact public mutation/control replay are now persisted with input hashes, aggregate verdicts, code fingerprint, and deterministic configuration; no hidden partition is read.

latest_replay.resolution: COUNT(column) vs COUNT(*) receives a nullable filtered-row witness when the schema permits it; duplicate source column names are classified as INPUT_GAP because normalization would change SQL name-resolution semantics; the independent Gold Oracle now also plants membership witnesses for simple IN subqueries.

latest_replay_v5.resolution: Unicode/numeric-leading identifier literal seeding is covered by the independent oracle; duplicate source columns remain explicit INPUT_GAP.

contract_decision.verification_scope: bounded Phase 1 implementation and frozen mutation/control pair gate; not a global SQL equivalence proof
contract_decision.reason: 新 hidden snapshot v25/v26 已满足 generation_failures=0、determinate_label_mismatches=0、repeat_run_stable=true、acceptance.pass=true；当前契约 20 个 capability ID 已由 10 个形式化 layer、CFG feature-family binding 或 FrozenPair gate 恰好覆盖，public 9778-pair replay 已保存可重放报告，Gold、production、CFG/IR、scope、dialect、witness 和 resource regression 均保留可追溯证据。VERIFIED 仅表示契约声明范围内的有界实现与冻结门禁通过；vendor 缺失 runner、复杂方言/递归边界、跨实例常驻 worker 等仍按 ENGINE_GAP/UNDECIDED 或显式 out-of-scope fail-closed。
